items.title: AI tools are spreading at work. Are they actually helping?
items.businessQuestion: If a business gives employees AI tools, what should managers measure to know whether the tools are actually helping?
items.connection: This connects to the Course Introduction because BUS123 is about using technology to solve business problems. Students can see that adopting a tool is only the first step; managers also need data, workflow changes, training, and quality checks.
items.discussionPrompt: Imagine a company adds AI tools for writing, research, spreadsheet cleanup, or customer service. List three things the manager should track: one speed metric, one quality metric, and one employee-support metric.
